items.title: UnitedHealth and other insurance stocks drag down the Dow after CMS proposes new anti-fraud rule
items.summary: Healthcare stocks fell again on Wednesday after the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) proposed a new rule that would toughen oversight of Medicare, Medicaid, the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), and the health insurance marketplace.
